start.text: The new defenses are in place. This thief does not shout. It takes a little, and then a little more.
start.name: Joshua

A.text: Joshua! It does not break anything. It leaks, it grabs, and it knocks on doors you forgot were there.
A.name: Carla

B.text: A quiet trickle, a big grab and a hidden door. That is three tricks.
B.name: Joshua

C.text: Each one is different. Small and steady can cost more than big and rare.
C.name: Carla

D1.text: [b][color=red]Quiet trickle[/color][/b]: tiny hits that add [b][color=red]Leak[/color][/b]. [b][color=red]Big grab[/color][/b]: one huge package that follows you. [b][color=red]Hidden door[/color][/b]: a lane that fires along the whole box.
D1.name: Carla

D2.text: That depends on the upgrades you equipped. Each trick has one defense that stops it. Without it, the trick comes back [b][color=red]harder[/color][/b].
D2.name: Carla

E.text: Use your cards to hit it, and spend [b][color=green]Charge[/color][/b] wisely. When it attacks, you dodge. Keep going until it is [b][color=green]contained[/color][/b].
E.name: Carla

F.text: Understood. Let's close this before anything more leaves.
F.name: Joshua

G.text: Everything I set up in Hardening is about to be tested.
G.name: Joshua
